tasks.title: Independently verify the consumer UX overhaul
tasks.summary: Audit the exact integrated revision against every merged UX acceptance signal, existing MVP boundary, rendered desktop/narrow evidence, and the real-process workflow.
tasks.objective: Issue the binding final APPROVE or REJECT decision for the post-MVP consumer UX milestone.
tasks.context: Automated checks are necessary but cannot prove usable hierarchy, grouping, copy, progressive disclosure, or responsive visual quality. Reviewer rejection is binding.
allowed_areas: Read all repository files, history, PR diffs, task runs, reviews, tests, screenshots, traces, and verification artifacts
Review notes and final UX acceptance report
inputs: Merged UX requirements and planning package
Canonical UX task runs and implementation PRs
implementation_notes: Review actual rendered onboarding, Settings, feed, expanded explanation, reader, Sources, Library, empty/error states, and approximately 390px layouts.
Reject work that remains confusing, inconsistently spaced/grouped, visually competitive, technically worded, inaccessible, or raw-model-oriented even when tests pass.
Trace semantic ranking controls to persisted backend configuration and confirm the frontend does not duplicate ranking or explanations.
Confirm all original local-only, credential, permission, scraper, persistence, demographic, loopback, and Windows boundaries remain intact.
Do not implement fixes or merge while acting as reviewer.
acceptance_criteria: Every post-MVP UX requirement has implementation plus observable exact-revision proof, including meaningful desktop and narrow screenshots.
A new user can understand and complete interests, Hungary/Budapest location, optional demographics, and sources without raw weights or administrative-schema knowledge.
Feed refresh, filters, cards, explanations, reading/library actions, Sources, Settings, and Library form one deliberate accessible responsive application.
No unexplained raw numeric weights or long contribution floats appear in normal workflows; advanced disclosures remain truthful and subordinate.
Real-process restart, interruption/recovery, keyboard, accessibility, storage, outbound-request, content-permission, credential, ranking, and Windows evidence passes at the exact revision.
All implementation PRs have independent approved reviews with blocking findings resolved and lifecycle records remain truthful.
verification: Inspect and, where practical, rerun full CI and task-specific component/browser verification from the exact revision.
Run or inspect the real Go/SQLite/Vue workflow, process restart transcript, accessibility report, browser-storage audit, and loopback-only request audit.
Compare screenshots across desktop/narrow screens for hierarchy, grouping, spacing, action priority, field clarity, overflow, and consistency.
Perform representative keyboard-only setup, filtering, explanation, source, and library actions.
Trace preserved ranking, demographic, persistence, permission, credential, and scraper-policy invariants through code and tests.
edge_cases: Check passed on an older commit
Raw score hidden visually but exposed accessibly
tasks.handoff_notes: Only an explicit exact-revision APPROVE completes the Consumer UX overhaul milestone; any unresolved blocker returns work to the responsible task.
